Sample: 1A 
Score: 9 
 
The student earned all 9 points. 
 
Sample: 1B 
Score: 6 
 
The student earned 6 points: 1 point in part (a), 2 points in part (b), 2 points in part (c), and 1 point in part (d). In 
part (a) the student presents a correct value for
